entry.title: Cassyni talk: Lighting and circadian cues

link.title: Cassyni talk: Lighting and circadian cues

entry.content:
I presented Lighting and circadian cues shape locomotor strategies for balance and navigation in larval zebrafish in Cassyni’s Ecology and evolution seminars series.

The talk explores how lighting and circadian cues shape the swimming strategies that larval zebrafish use to maintain balance and navigate their environment.

The related paper is now published in Proceedings of the Royal Society B: Biological Sciences.

Read the paper · PDF · Data
